مِطْحَانٌ A viper turning round about; or coiling itself. (S, K.) A poet says, “بِخَرْسَآءَ مِطْحَانٍ كَأَنَّ فَحِيحَهَا
إِذَا فَزِعَتْ مَآءٌ هُرِيقَ عَلَى جَمْرِ
” [With a coiling viper, as though its hissing, when it is frightened, were the sound of water poured upon live coals]. (S, TA.) ―
-b2- See also طَاحُونَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
